name: Livery Cruiser
description: A Livery Cruiser was a class of cruiser that was used during the New Republic Era. It was considered more "pleasant" for interstellar travel than gunships such as the Razor Crest. In 9 ABY, a Mythrol on the ice planet of Pagodon attempted to ingratiate himself to his captor—the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin—by suggesting that he could hail a Livery Cruiser for them.
